description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.
